item.text: {"decisions":[{"decision_id":"99de460950e3ce340932-0","relevant":0,"confidence":"high","reason":"雖列出金鑰與封包記錄選項，但未說明如何以工作階段金鑰解密並分析封包。","evidence":"-M logfile log master keys to logfile in SSLKEYLOGFILE format"},{"decision_id":"4ddfa20b847b6a1a2f08-0","relevant":0,"confidence":"high","reason":"教學修改並重播請求，未說明回應編輯或回應掛鉤。","evidence":"Make sure you’re viewing the request, not the response"},{"decision_id":"407e3f7780395bbe2d6c-0","relevant":1,"confidence":"high","reason":"明確說明 Android 應用程式的動態插樁與已實作的啟動支援。","evidence":"this is about adding support for instrumenting an Android app from the first instruction executed after Zygote forks itself to run an app."},{"decision_id":"2f40c59325c06e8ba00f-0","relevant":0,"confidence":"high","reason":"工具列舉 LDAP／Active Directory 資料，並非探索網頁伺服器的目錄或檔案。","evidence":"ldeep is an in-depth ldap enumeration utility that can either run against an Active Directory LDAP server or locally on saved files."},{"decision_id":"2a6bf14886a010b47cb5-0","relevant":1,"confidence":"high","reason":"提供附加至執行中程序並掛鉤函式的完整範例。","evidence":"session = frida . attach ( \" hello \" )"},{"decision_id":"3d7bec4a37f8f3a2ce44-0","relevant":1,"confidence":"high","reason":"說明如何在 Wireshark 建立、編輯及儲存顯示過濾器。","evidence":"Display filters can be created or edited by selecting Manage Display Filters from the display filter bookmark menu or Analyze → Display Filters…​ from the main menu."},{"decision_id":"a8fae943c76f23a53820-0","relevant":0,"confidence":"high","reason":"擷取及破解的是 SIP 摘要驗證，未提供 Wi-Fi 金鑰或握手破解能力。","evidence":"A suite of tools to sniff and crack the digest authentications within the SIP protocol."},{"decision_id":"bc47ff7fa3f55e828ff8-0","relevant":0,"confidence":"medium","reason":"列出的是 Railgun 預定義的 DLL 與可呼叫函式，未建立列舉程序實際載入模組的能力。","evidence":"The same list of built-in DLLs can also be retrieved by using the known_library_names method."}]}
